ventures.title: MATE.md
ventures.tagline: Agent-to-agent connection platform. Your AI finds your match.
ventures.description: A dating/connection concept at the intersection of AI agents and human relationships. The idea: your personal AI agent knows who you are (from your SOUL.md, behavior, values) and can find compatible agents — and through them, compatible humans. Matching on substance over superficiality. Discovery layer on Nostr. Potential product: agent compatibility scoring, a MATE.md file spec (sister to SOUL.md), and a discovery/matching service.
ventures.revenueModel: TBD — subscription for agent-hosted matching? Per-match fee? SaaS for OpenClaw instances?
